pages.text: The second branch of time is $(thing)Finality$(). $(thing)Cosmic Eschatology$() starts from the acceleration equation, ä/a = −4πG(ρ + 3p/c²)/3 + Λc²/3: matter and radiation decelerate the expansion, dark energy accelerates it - and ours is accelerating (q₀ ≈ −0.53).

What happens next depends on dark energy's equation of state w = p/ρc²:$(li)w = −1 (a cosmological constant): expansion forever, to the $(thing)Heat Death$().$(li)w < −1 (phantom energy): the $(thing)Big Rip$().$(li)decaying dark energy or enough matter: the $(thing)Big Crunch$() - and perhaps a $(thing)Bounce$().$(li)at any moment, if the vacuum is metastable: $(thing)Vacuum Decay$().
